title: Private vs Government Hospital: What changes?
source_idea: Comparison between private hospital vs government hospital

scenes.voice: Ever wondered what really changes between a private and government hospital?
It is rarely just about the comfort of the room. It often impacts your choice of doctors.
In some setups, you can select your preferred specialist. In others, doctors are assigned to you.
Waiting times for non-emergency procedures can also vary significantly between the two.
Your policy wording explains exactly how your specific plan handles different hospital types.
Follow to understand your insurance better, one simple concept at a time.

caption:
Hospital choices can impact your care experience and costs. 🏥

Always check your policy wording to understand how your coverage applies.
